name: PreStocks Feasibility Test (E-PRESTOCKS Gate)
question: Does Colophon qualify for the PreStocks bounty track? Do all 8 gate requirements pass?
hypothesis: OPENAI and SPACEX PreStocks satisfy all 8 gate requirements. Colophon is eligible for both Main Track and PreStocks Track.
method: Systematic gate check against §16 requirements. Evidence from on-chain measurements (E1.5), API data, and architectural decisions.

gates.name: Confirm official PreStocks eligibility requirements
gates.requirement: Use PreStocks mints. Do not integrate non-PreStocks pre-IPO tokens.
gates.evidence: PreStocks mints are Token-2022 tokens deployed at prestocks.com. Colophon uses ONLY the mints listed in the PreStocks API (prestocks.com/api/prestocks). No other pre-IPO token sources.
gates.limitation: Cannot read StockLana official bounty rules from this environment — based on §16 of instruction which states the requirement.

gates.name: Identify real PreStock instrument using ScaledUiAmount
gates.requirement: At least one real PreStock must use ScaledUiAmount.

gates.name: Run the same timeline reconstruction
gates.requirement: The same temporal kernel must work for PreStocks as for xStocks.
gates.evidence: The activeMultiplier(cfg, nowTs) function is universal — it reads ScaledUiAmountConfig regardless of whether the mint is a PreStock or xStock. Both OPENAI and SPACEX divergences were found and measured by the same dollar-divergence-hunt.mjs script that will also process xStocks.
gates.kernelUniversality: The kernel treats any Token-2022 mint with ScaledUiAmountConfig identically. The only difference is the instrument adapter (terminology: TOKEN UNITS for PreStocks, SHARES for xStocks).

gates.name: Demonstrate same kernel works without cloning architecture
gates.requirement: Must not require a separate application architecture for PreStocks.
gates.evidence: packages/kernel is a single temporal accounting library. packages/instruments adds an adapter with two subclasses: XStocksInstrument (terminology: shares) and PreStocksInstrument (terminology: token units / economic exposure). One product, two adapters.
gates.architecturePattern:
ONE TEMPORAL ENGINE
         │
         ├── PUBLIC EQUITY ADAPTER (xStocks) → SHARES / TOKENIZED STOCK UNITS
         └── PRE-IPO EXPOSURE ADAPTER (PreStocks) → TOKEN UNITS / ECONOMIC EXPOSURE

gates.name: Small instrument adapter — not a new product
gates.requirement: PreStocks support must be an adapter, not a separate app.
gates.evidence: The PreStocks instrument adapter changes: (a) API source, (b) display terminology, (c) disclaimer text. No new accounting logic. No second kernel. No separate frontend.

gates.name: Distinguish public-stock shares vs. private-company economic exposure
gates.requirement: Must not call a PreStock token a legal share.
gates.evidence: All UI text, documentation, and export files will use the correct terminology. The /statement page for PreStocks will explicitly state: 'TOKEN UNITS — economic exposure to [company] private market price. Not a legal share.'

gates.name: No non-PreStocks pre-IPO token integration
gates.requirement: Integrating a non-PreStocks pre-IPO token makes the project ineligible for the PreStocks bounty.
gates.evidence: Colophon ONLY integrates: (1) xStocks mints from api.xstocks.fi — public tokenized equities, (2) PreStocks mints from prestocks.com/api/prestocks — official PreStocks. No other pre-IPO token source.

checklist.item: No other private pre-IPO token platforms
Only prestocks.com mints used for PreStocks track

gates.name: Record eligibility evidence
gates.evidence: This document (e7_prestocks_feasibility.json) serves as the eligibility record. It contains: gate checks, mint addresses, on-chain measurements, terminology rules, and architecture decisions.

claim: PROVEN: All 8 E-PRESTOCKS gate requirements pass. Colophon is eligible for the PreStocks track. OPENAI and SPACEX are real PreStocks mints with ScaledUiAmountConfig. The same temporal kernel handles both public-equity xStocks and private-company PreStocks.
limitations: Gate G1 relies on §16 of instruction for eligibility definition — cannot access official StockLana bounty rules from this environment.
Gate G3 proven by architecture decision — kernel code is written in Phase 1.
Terminology compliance (G6) enforced in Phase 3 (UI) and Phase 5 (polish).
